d: Elon Musk wanted his AI tool, Grok, to take on Hollywood with a full-length adaptation of The Odyssey. Three months later, the result was just a seven-minute video, drawing criticism for its lacklustre execution. But is AI filmmaking being judged too harshly, or is there something human creativity brings to the screen that machines cannot replicate? From cutting production costs to the art of storytelling, Palki Sharma examines whether AI is ready to make movies, or is still a long way from replacing human filmmakers.
